title.en: EMERGENCY FINANCE COMPANIES ACT AMENDMENT ORDER 1995

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-32_1995_E-EMERGENCY-FINANCE-COMPANIES-ACT-AMENDMENT-ORDER-1995.pdf》（3 页），本次切分 1 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en:
Subsection (2) of section 38 of the Act is amended by deleting "His Amendment of Majesty in Council" and substituting therefor "the Minister with the section 38. approval of His Majesty The Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan". Made this 29th day of Zulhijah, 1415 Hijrah corresponding to the 29th day of May, 1995 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Brunei Darussalam.

HIS MAJESTY

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM
